implementation.speed: available runtime speed; no separate override
implementation.generation: Deterministic authored analytic surfaces; no AI bitmap generation, no failed contest design mining.

templateMap.placementScaleRecipe: source s * original sampled sx/sy/sz; no normalization or hidden fit factor
templateMap.pivotRecipe: repeat world center as aPivot vec3 for every stamped corner
templateMap.spinRecipe: repeat original normalized axis xyz and rad/s speed as aSpin vec4 for every corner
templateMap.vertexPaletteRecipe: multiply actual Batch linear tint colors by exported linear COLOR_0 per indexed corner
templateMap.uvRecipe: actual Batch dominant triangle-axis world box projection at uvScale=2*s; imported UVs are preview/edit data

baselineSummary.rngRecipe: Each successful iteration: 1 condition int + 3 placement + 1 radius + 1 z + 3 axis + 5 rockGeometry + 1 tint + 1 speed = 16 next(); final failed condition = 1. Landmarks before and wreck/truss after are additional, executed unmodified.

limitations: CPU actual-source prototype; MeshBasicMaterial test double avoids DOM canvas Materials construction, not a live shader or GPU timing test.
Sphere and 3-unit sight capsule candidates overestimate mesh overlap. Negative clearance is not proof of actual occlusion; no claim of all-seed camera safety.
Full-spin per-axis bounds are analytic for triangles under Rodrigues rotation; placement values are not normalized or rescaled to improve comparisons.
Gate ring and wall rocks remain legacy source topology. Boundary non-space chunks and transient retained chunks differ from all-space proxy.
Aggregate counts are asteroid-only, not whole-game triangles, memory, draw calls, or FPS.

binaryAudit.method: Independent Python standard-library GLB chunk/accessor/node transform/index/welded edge audit; not the Blender exporter or importer.

omitted: all non-asteroid scenery, enemies, UI and postprocessing
evidenceTruth.materialApproximation: neutral .74 attenuation on linear seed tint and authored palette; actual source map/rim response documented, not claimed rendered
evidenceTruth.bounds: actual sampled placement/anisotropy; analytic full-spin axis bounds and conservative pivot sphere; no normalized comparisons

knownLimits: CPU actual-source prototype; MeshBasicMaterial test double avoids DOM canvas Materials construction, not a live shader or GPU timing test.
Sphere and 3-unit sight capsule candidates overestimate mesh overlap. Negative clearance is not proof of actual occlusion; no claim of all-seed camera safety.
Full-spin per-axis bounds are analytic for triangles under Rodrigues rotation; placement values are not normalized or rescaled to improve comparisons.
Gate ring and wall rocks remain legacy source topology. Boundary non-space chunks and transient retained chunks differ from all-space proxy.
Aggregate counts are asteroid-only, not whole-game triangles, memory, draw calls, or FPS.
Classic camera has inherited conservative sphere/capsule candidates; zero newly flagged sample events versus source is not all-seed proof.
Eye sphere uses .35 radius; it does not certify complete projected near-plane clearance, especially the wide orthographic Classic near plane.
Camera snap samples exclude shake/boost/lag trajectories, other aspect ratios, target visibility, and actual GPU shader/depth behavior.
Offline camera-parented label geometry can cast minor shadows in closeup evidence; these labels are not part of delivered mesh assets.
Initial authored craft only; Opus formal review/polish intentionally deferred. No formal review or fix pass performed.
